name: RACI
title: RACI Doesn't Work Until Exactly One Person Is Accountable
subtitle: Three people accountable for the same control means zero people accountable for it.

cover.alt: Three A's means no A: the same reconciliation break in a RACI matrix with three Accountable teams versus one with Ops Accountable, Risk Consulted and Technology Informed
cover.caption: The same reconciliation break, run through two RACI matrices.
cover.use: Cover: top of the post (and Substack social preview)

substack.email_subject: Three teams were accountable. The break sat open for 11 days.
substack.note:
A reconciliation break sat unresolved for eleven days. Ops assumed Risk had it. Risk assumed Ops had it. Technology assumed they both did. The RACI matrix listed all three as Accountable.

Three A's in one row isn't extra cover. It's covered by nobody in particular.
